name: Airtable

field_reviews.reason: Live authentication docs: 'Any integrations that allow other users to grant access to Airtable should use OAuth', with tokens issued via the OAuth grant flow after registering at /create/oauth. For third-party integration use (the relevant framing), OAuth authorization code is the primary method; PATs are for personal development.

Authentication page confirms personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens, both passed as 'Authorization: Bearer' headers; legacy api_key parameter is not supported (deprecation completed Feb 1 2024).

Airtable has a free plan; PATs are created self-serve at airtable.com/create/tokens and OAuth integrations registered self-serve at /create/oauth. The official MCP support article lists 'Plan availability: All plans', confirming API/MCP reach the free tier.
Web API covers records CRUD, base/table/field schema management, base creation, comments, webhooks, and enterprise endpoints; Composio wraps 26 tools including create base/table/field. Broad is fair.

REST Web API at api.airtable.com confirmed; official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp confirmed in the Airtable support article (verified via Claude Code setup command 'claude mcp add --transport http airtable https://mcp.airtable.com/mcp').

Vendor ownership verified: the MCP server is documented on support.airtable.com (updated Aug 10 2026), hosted on airtable.com's own mcp.airtable.com domain, auth via OAuth or PAT, and can read/write records, create bases, and build interfaces/automation drafts, matching the draft's notes. Composio AIRTABLE toolkit page confirms 26 tools, 6 triggers, OAUTH2/API_KEY.
Free self-serve plan, self-serve tokens/OAuth registration, broad REST API, official webhooks, official MCP: buildable today.
No blocker. Only caveat (correctly captured in draft uncertainty notes) is that enterprise admins can restrict third-party integrations, which is not a default gate.

notes: Independently re-opened airtable.com/developers/web/api/authentication, the webhooks API overview/create-webhook pages (webhook:manage scope, all billing plans, 7-day expiry matching draft uncertainty notes), the official MCP support article, and the Composio AIRTABLE toolkit page. All eight fields hold with no corrections.
